title: Federal Reserve September meeting and guidance
rationale: Headlines note Fed officials (Waller/Williams) and a September meeting could alter rate expectations (e.g. 'Fed Governor Waller indicates he will support holding rates steady at September meeting').

title: Ongoing oil and European gas price surge (Middle East tensions)
rationale: Multiple headlines link oil/gas surge and Mideast turmoil to bond sell-off (e.g. 'Energy price surge hits bond markets', 'Global Bond Yields Surge as Oil Prices Fuel Inflation Worries').

title: Fed officials' communications ahead of policy meeting
rationale: Headlines highlight Waller and Williams remarks moving yields and sentiment (e.g. 'Fed Governor Waller indicates he will support holding rates steady', 'Fed’s Williams “is opening options”').

title: Bank of Japan September rate repricing
rationale: Headlines: 'BOJ chief signals chance of September rate hike' and 'Bank of Japan’s Ueda vows to keep raising interest rates.'

title: ECB policy guidance and rate path
rationale: Headlines: 'ECB must be prepared to lift interest rates further' and damage to French government bonds from hawkish ECB remarks.

title: Emerging-market credit stress from higher global yields
rationale: IMF and news warn rising yields threaten developing-country debt and bailouts (e.g. 'IMF's Georgieva says rising bond yields threaten progress', 'IMF agrees $2.2bn bailout for Senegal').

title: Continued net inflows into bond funds
rationale: Headline: 'Rising yields aren’t scaring off investors. Why money is still pouring into bond funds.'

title: Potential BOJ/finance ministry FX intervention to curb yen moves
rationale: Headlines note 'intervention chatter' and 'Yen jumps as traders bet on Japan interest rate rises', implying intervention risk.
